# netactuate_cloud_floating_ipv4_vms (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Floating IPv4 VMs visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_floating_ipv4_vms" "example" {
  floating_ipv4_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `floating_ipv4_id` (Number) Floating IPv4 ID whose allowed virtual machines should be read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vms` (List of Object) Virtual machines allowed to access the floating IPv4 address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `fqdn` (String)
- `ip` (String)
- `mbpkgid` (Number)
